ταβερναι.def: plural of Latin origin; huts or wooden-walled buildings; Tabernæ. KJV: taverns.

ταβιθα.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H6646); the gazelle; Tabitha (i.e. Tabjetha), a Christian female. KJV: Tabitha.

ταγμα.def: from τάσσω (G5021); something orderly in arrangement (a troop), i.e. (figuratively) a series or succession. KJV: order.

τακτοσ.def: from τάσσω (G5021); arranged, i.e. appointed or stated. KJV: set.

ταλαιπωρεω.def: from ταλαίπωρος (G5005); to be wretched, i.e. realize one's own misery. KJV: be afflicted.

ταλαιπωρια.def: from ταλαίπωρος (G5005); wretchedness, i.e. calamity. KJV: misery.

ταλαιπωροσ.def: from the base of τάλαντον (G5007) and a derivative of the base of πεῖρα (G3984); enduring trial, i.e. miserable. KJV: wretched.

ταλαντιαιοσ.def: from τάλαντον (G5007); talent-like in weight. KJV: weight of a talent.

ταλαντον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of the original form of τλάω (to bear; equivalent to φέρω (G5342)); a balance (as supporting weights), i.e. (by implication) a certain weight (and thence a coin or rather sum of money) or "talent". KJV: talent.

ταλιθα.def: of Chaldee origin (compare H2924); the fresh, i.e. young girl; talitha (O maiden). KJV: talitha.

ταμειον.def: neuter contraction of a presumed derivative of ταμίας (a dispenser or distributor; akin to τέμνω, to cut); a dispensary or magazine, i.e. a chamber on the ground-floor or interior of an Oriental house (generally used for storage or privacy, a spot for retirement). KJV: secret chamber, closet, storehouse.

τανυν.def: from neuter plural of ὁ (G3588) and νῦν (G3568); the things now, i.e. (adverbially) at present. KJV: (but) now.

ταξισ.def: from τάσσω (G5021); regular arrangement, i.e. (in time) fixed succession (of rank or character), official dignity. KJV: order.

ταπεινοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; depressed, i.e. (figuratively) humiliated (in circumstances or disposition). KJV: base, cast down, humble, of low degree (estate), lowly.

ταπεινοφροσυνη.def: from a compound of ταπεινός (G5011) and the base of φρήν (G5424); humiliation of mind, i.e. modesty. KJV: humbleness of mind, humility (of mind, loneliness (of mind).

ταπεινοω.def: from ταπεινός (G5011); to depress; figuratively, to humiliate (in condition or heart). KJV: abase, bring low, humble (self).

ταπεινωσισ.def: from ταπεινόω (G5013); depression (in rank or feeling). KJV: humiliation, be made low, low estate, vile.

ταρασσω.def: of uncertain affinity; to stir or agitate (roil water). KJV: trouble.

ταραχη.def: feminine from ταράσσω (G5015); disturbance, i.e. (of water) roiling, or (of a mob) sedition. KJV: trouble(-ing).

ταραχοσ.def: masculine from ταράσσω (G5015); a disturbance, i.e. (popular) tumult. KJV: stir.

ταρσευσ.def: from Ταρσός (G5019); a Tarsean, i.e. native of Tarsus. KJV: of Tarsus.

ταρσοσ.def: perhaps the same as ταρσός (a flat basket); Tarsus, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Tarsus.

ταρταροω.def: from Τάρταρος (the deepest abyss of Hades); to incarcerate in eternal torment. KJV: cast down to hell.

τασσω.def: a prolonged form of a primary verb (which latter appears only in certain tenses); to arrange in an orderly manner, i.e. assign or dispose (to a certain position or lot). KJV: addict, appoint, determine, ordain, set.

ταυροσ.def: apparently a primary word (compare H8450, "steer"); a bullock. KJV: bull, ox.

ταυτα.def: nominative or accusative case neuter plural of οὗτος (G3778); these things. KJV: + afterward, follow, + hereafter, X him, the same, so, such, that, then, these, they, this, those, thus.
neuter plural of ὁ (G3588) and αὐτός (G846) as adverb; in the same way. KJV: even thus, (manner) like, so.

ταυταισ.def: dative case and accusative case feminine plural respectively of οὗτος (G3778); (to or with or by, etc.) these. KJV: hence, that, then, these, those.

ταυτη.def: dative case, accusative case and genitive case respectively of the feminine singular of οὗτος (G3778); (towards or of) this. KJV: her, + hereof, it, that, + thereby, the (same), this (same).

ταφη.def: feminine from θάπτω (G2290); burial (the act). KJV: X bury.

ταφοσ.def: masculine from θάπτω (G2290); a grave (the place of interment). KJV: sepulchre, tomb.

ταχα.def: as if neuter plural of ταχύς (G5036) (adverbially); shortly, i.e. (figuratively) possibly. KJV: peradventure(-haps).

ταχεωσ.def: adverb from ταχύς (G5036); briefly, i.e. (in time) speedily, or (in manner) rapidly. KJV: hastily, quickly, shortly, soon, suddenly.

ταχινοσ.def: from τάχος (G5034); curt, i.e. impending. KJV: shortly, swift.

ταχιον.def: neuter singular of the comparative of ταχύς (G5036) (as adverb); more swiftly, i.e. (in manner) more rapidly, or (in time) more speedily. KJV: out (run), quickly, shortly, sooner.

ταχιστα.def: neuter plural of the superlative of ταχύς (G5036) (as adverb); most quickly, i.e. (with ὡς (G5613) prefixed) as soon as possible. KJV: + with all speed.

ταχοσ.def: from the same as ταχύς (G5036); a brief space (of time), i.e. (with ἐν (G1722) prefixed) in haste. KJV: + quickly, + shortly, + speedily.

ταχυ.def: neuter singular of ταχύς (G5036) (as adverb); shortly, i.e. without delay, soon, or (by surprise) suddenly, or (by implication, of ease) readily. KJV: lightly, quickly.

ταχυσ.def: of uncertain affinity; fleet, i.e. (figuratively) prompt or ready. KJV: swift.

τε.def: a primary particle (enclitic) of connection or addition; both or also (properly, as correlation of καί (G2532)). KJV: also, and, both, even, then, whether.

τειχοσ.def: akin to the base of τίκτω (G5088); a wall (as formative of a house). KJV: wall.

τεκμηριον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of τεκμάρ (a goal or fixed limit); a token (as defining a fact), i.e. criterion of certainty. KJV: infallible proof.

τεκνιον.def: diminutive of τέκνον (G5043); an infant, i.e. (plural figuratively) darlings (Christian converts). KJV: little children.

τεκνογονεω.def: from a compound of τέκνον (G5043) and the base of γίνομαι (G1096); to be a child-bearer, i.e. parent (mother). KJV: bear children.

τεκνογονια.def: from the same as τεκνογονέω (G5041); childbirth (parentage), i.e. (by implication) maternity (the performance of maternal duties). KJV: childbearing.

τεκνον.def: from the base of τιμωρία (G5098); a child (as produced). KJV: child, daughter, son.

τεκνοτροφεω.def: from a compound of τέκνον (G5043) and τρέφω (G5142); to be a childrearer, i.e. fulfil the duties of a female parent. KJV: bring up children.

τεκτων.def: from the base of τιμωρία (G5098); an artificer (as producer of fabrics), i.e. (specially), a craftsman in wood. KJV: carpenter.

τελειοσ.def: from τέλος (G5056); complete (in various applications of labor, growth, mental and moral character, etc.); neuter (as noun, with ὁ (G3588)) completeness. KJV: of full age, man, perfect.

τελειοτησ.def: from τέλειος (G5046); (the state) completeness (mentally or morally). KJV: perfection(-ness).

τελειοω.def: from τέλειος (G5046); to complete, i.e. (literally) accomplish, or (figuratively) consummate (in character). KJV: consecrate, finish, fulfil, make) perfect.

τελειωσ.def: adverb from τέλειος (G5046); completely, i.e. (of hope) without wavering. KJV: to the end.

τελειωσισ.def: from φυσιόω (G5448); (the act) completion, i.e. (of prophecy) verification, or (of expiation) absolution. KJV: perfection, performance.

τελειωτησ.def: from τελειόω (G5048); a completer, i.e. consummater. KJV: finisher.

τελεσφορεω.def: from a compound of τέλος (G5056) and φέρω (G5342); to be a bearer to completion (maturity), i.e. to ripen fruit (figuratively). KJV: bring fruit to perfection.

τελευταω.def: from a presumed derivative of τελέω (G5055); to finish life (by implication, of βίος (G979)), i.e. expire (demise). KJV: be dead, decease, die.

τελεω.def: from τέλος (G5056); to end, i.e. complete, execute, conclude, discharge (a debt). KJV: accomplish, make an end, expire, fill up, finish, go over, pay, perform.

τελοσ.def: from a primary τέλλω (to set out for a definite point or goal); properly, the point aimed at as a limit, i.e. (by implication) the conclusion of an act or state (termination (literally, figuratively or indefinitely), result (immediate, ultimate or prophetic), purpose); specially, an impost or levy (as paid). KJV: + continual, custom, end(-ing), finally, uttermost.

τελωνησ.def: from τέλος (G5056) and ὠνέομαι (G5608); a tax-farmer, i.e. collector of public revenue. KJV: publican.

τελωνιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of τελώνης (G5057); a tax-gatherer's place of business. KJV: receipt of custom.

τερασ.def: of uncertain affinity; a prodigy or omen. KJV: wonder.

τερτιοσ.def: of Latin origin; third; Tertius, a Christian. KJV: Tertius.

τερτυλλοσ.def: of uncertain derivation; Tertullus, a Roman. KJV: Tertullus.

τεσσαρακοντα.def: the decade of τέσσαρες (G5064); forty. KJV: forty.

τεσσαρακονταετησ.def: from τεσσαράκοντα (G5062) and ἔτος (G2094); of forty years of age. KJV: (+ full, of) forty years (old).

τεσσαρεσ.def: a plural number; four. KJV: four.

τεσσαρεσκαιδεκατοσ.def: from τέσσαρες (G5064) and καί (G2532) and δέκατος (G1182); fourteenth. KJV: fourteenth.

τεταρταιοσ.def: from τέσσαρες (G5064); pertaining to the fourth day. KJV: four days.

τεταρτοσ.def: ordinal from τέσσαρες (G5064); fourth. KJV: four(-th).

τετραγωνοσ.def: from τέσσαρες (G5064) and γωνία (G1137); four-cornered, i.e. square. KJV: foursquare.

τετραδιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of τέτρας (a tetrad; from τέσσαρες (G5064)); a quaternion or squad (picket) of four Roman soldiers. KJV: quaternion.

τετρακισχιλιοι.def: from the multiplicative adverb of τέσσαρες (G5064) and χίλιοι (G5507); four times a thousand. KJV: four thousand.

τετρακοσιοι.def: plural from τέσσαρες (G5064) and ἑκατόν (G1540); four hundred. KJV: four hundred.

τετραμηνον.def: neuter of a compound of τέσσαρες (G5064) and μήν (G3376); a four months' space. KJV: four months.

τετραπλοοσ.def: from τέσσαρες (G5064) and a derivative of the base of πλεῖστος (G4118); quadruple. KJV: fourfold.

τετραπουσ.def: from τέσσαρες (G5064) and πούς (G4228); a quadruped. KJV: fourfooted beast.

τετραρχεω.def: from τετράρχης (G5076); to be a tetrarch. KJV: (be) tetrarch.

τετραρχησ.def: from τέσσαρες (G5064) and ἄρχω (G757); the ruler of a fourth part of a country ("tetrarch"). KJV: tetrarch.

τεφροω.def: from τέφρα (ashes); to incinerate, i.e. consume. KJV: turn to ashes.

τεχνη.def: from the base of τίκτω (G5088); art (as productive), i.e. (specially), a trade, or (generally) skill. KJV: art, craft, occupation.

τεχνιτησ.def: from τέχνη (G5078); an artisan; figuratively, a founder (Creator). KJV: builder, craftsman.

τηκω.def: apparently a primary verb; to liquefy. KJV: melt.

τηλαυγωσ.def: adverb from a compound of a derivative of τέλος (G5056) and αὐγή (G827); in a far-shining manner, i.e. plainly. KJV: clearly.

τηλικουτοσ.def: from a compound of ὁ (G3588) with ἡλίκος (G2245) and οὗτος (G3778); such as this, i.e. (in (figurative) magnitude) so vast. KJV: so great, so mighty.

τηρεω.def: from τερός (a watch; perhaps akin to θεωρέω (G2334)); to guard (from loss or injury, properly, by keeping the eye upon; and thus differing from φυλάσσω (G5442), which is properly to prevent escaping; and from κουστωδία (G2892), which implies a fortress or full military lines of apparatus), i.e. to note (a prophecy; figuratively, to fulfil a command); by implication, to detain (in custody; figuratively, to maintain); by extension, to withhold (for personal ends; figuratively, to keep unmarried); by extension, to withhold (for personal ends; figuratively, to keep unmarried). KJV: hold fast, keep(- er), (pre-, re-)serve, watch.

τηρησισ.def: from τηρέω (G5083); a watching, i.e. (figuratively) observance, or (concretely) a prison. KJV: hold.

τιβεριασ.def: from Τιβέριος (G5086); Tiberias, the name of a town and a lake in Palestine. KJV: Tiberias.

τιβεριοσ.def: of Latin origin; probably pertaining to the river Tiberis or Tiber; Tiberius, a Roman emperor. KJV: Tiberius.

τιθημι.def: a prolonged form of a primary θέω (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses); to place (in the widest application, literally and figuratively; properly, in a passive or horizontal posture, and thus different from ἵστημι (G2476), which properly denotes an upright and active position, while κεῖμαι (G2749) is properly reflexive and utterly prostrate). KJV: + advise, appoint, bow, commit, conceive, give, X kneel down, lay (aside, down, up), make, ordain, purpose, put, set (forth), settle, sink down.

τικτω.def: a strengthened form of a primary τέκω (which is used only as alternate in certain tenses); to produce (from seed, as a mother, a plant, the earth, etc.), literally or figuratively. KJV: bear, be born, bring forth, be delivered, be in travail.

τιλλω.def: perhaps akin to the alternate of αἱρέομαι (G138), and thus to σύρω (G4951); to pull off. KJV: pluck.

τιμαιοσ.def: probably of Chaldee origin (compare H2931); Timæus (i.e. Timay), an Israelite. KJV: Timæus.

τιμαω.def: from τίμιος (G5093); to prize, i.e. fix a valuation upon; by implication, to revere. KJV: honour, value.

τιμη.def: from τίνω (G5099); a value, i.e. money paid, or (concretely and collectively) valuables; by analogy, esteem (especially of the highest degree), or the dignity itself. KJV: honour, precious, price, some.

τιμιοσ.def: from τιμή (G5092); valuable, i.e. (objectively) costly, or (subjectively) honored, esteemed, or (figuratively) beloved. KJV: dear, honourable, (more, most) precious, had in reputation.

τιμιοτησ.def: from τίμιος (G5093); expensiveness, i.e. (by implication) magnificence. KJV: costliness.

τιμοθεοσ.def: from τιμή (G5092) and θεός (G2316); dear to God; Timotheus, a Christian. KJV: Timotheus, Timothy.

τιμων.def: from τιμή (G5092); valuable; Timon, a Christian. KJV: Timon.

τιμωρεω.def: from a comparative of τιμή (G5092) and οὖρος ouros (a guard); properly, to protect one's honor, i.e. to avenge (inflict a penalty). KJV: punish.

τιμωρια.def: from τιμωρέω (G5097); vindication, i.e. (by implication) a penalty. KJV: punishment.

τινω.def: strengthened for a primary τίω (which is only used as an alternate in certain tenses); to pay a price, i.e. as a penalty. KJV: be punished with.

τισ.def: an enclitic indefinite pronoun; some or any person or object. KJV: a (kind of), any (man, thing, thing at all), certain (thing), divers, he (every) man, one (X thing), ought, + partly, some (man, -body, - thing, -what), (+ that no-)thing, what(-soever), X wherewith, whom(-soever), whose(-soever).

probably emphatic of τὶς (G5100); an interrogative pronoun, who, which or what (in direct or indirect questions). KJV: every man, how (much), + no(-ne, thing), what (manner, thing), where (-by, -fore, -of, -unto, - with, -withal), whether, which, who(-m, -se), why.

τιτλοσ.def: of Latin origin; a titulus or "title" (placard). KJV: title.

τιτοσ.def: of Latin origin but uncertain significance; Titus, a Christian. KJV: Titus.

τοι.def: probably for the dative case of ὁ (G3588); an enclitic particle of asseveration by way of contrast; in sooth. KJV: (used only with other particles in the comparative, as καίτοιγε (G2544), μέντοι (G3305), τοιγαροῦν (G5105), τοίνυν (G5106), etc.

τοιγαρουν.def: from τοί (G5104) and γάρ (G1063) and οὖν (G3767); truly for then, i.e. consequently. KJV: there-(where-)fore.

τοινυν.def: from τοί (G5104) and νῦν (G3568); truly now, i.e. accordingly. KJV: then, therefore.

τοιοσδε.def: (including the other inflections); from a derivative of 5104 and δέ (G1161); such-like then, i.e. so great. KJV: such.

τοιουτοσ.def: (including the other inflections); from τοί (G5104) and οὗτος (G3778); truly this, i.e. of this sort (to denote character or individuality). KJV: like, such (an one).

τοιχοσ.def: another form of τεῖχος (G5038); a wall. KJV: wall.

τοκοσ.def: from the base of τίκτω (G5088); interest on money loaned (as a produce). KJV: usury.

τολμαω.def: from τόλμα (boldness; probably itself from the base of τέλος (G5056) through the idea of extreme conduct); to venture (objectively or in act; while θαῤῥέω (G2292) is rather subjective or in feeling); by implication, to be courageous. KJV: be bold, boldly, dare, durst.

τολμηροτερον.def: neuter of the compound of a derivative of the base of 5111 (as adverb); more daringly, i.e. with greater confidence than otherwise. KJV: the more boldly.

τολμητησ.def: from τολμάω (G5111); a daring (audacious) man. KJV: presumptuous.

τομωτεροσ.def: comparative of a derivative of the primary τέμνω (to cut; more comprehensive or decisive than κόπτω (G2875), as if by a single stroke; whereas that implies repeated blows, like hacking); more keen. KJV: sharper.

τοξον.def: from the base of τίκτω (G5088); a bow (apparently as the simplest fabric). KJV: bow.

τοπαζιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative (alternately) of τόπαζος (a "topaz"; of uncertain origin); a gem, probably the chrysolite. KJV: topaz.

τοποσ.def: apparently a primary word; a spot (general in space, but limited by occupancy; whereas χώρα (G5561) is a large but participle locality), i.e. location (as a position, home, tract, etc.); figuratively, condition, opportunity; specially, a scabbard. KJV: coast, licence, place, X plain, quarter, + rock, room, where.

τοσουτοσ.def: from τόσος (so much; apparently from ὁ (G3588) and ὅς (G3739)) and οὗτος (G3778) (including its variations); so vast as this, i.e. such (in quantity, amount, number of space). KJV: as large, so great (long, many, much), these many.

τοτε.def: from (the neuter of) ὁ (G3588) and ὅτε (G3753); the when, i.e. at the time that (of the past or future, also in consecution). KJV: that time, then.

του.def: properly, the genitive case of ὁ (G3588); sometimes used for τούτου (G5127); of this person. KJV: his.

τουναντιον.def: contraction for the neuter of ὁ (G3588) and ἐναντίον (G1726); on the contrary. KJV: contrariwise.

τουνομα.def: contraction for the neuter of ὁ (G3588) and ὄνομα (G3686); the name (is). KJV: named.

τουτεστι.def: contraction for τοῦτο (G5124) and ἐστί (G2076); that is. KJV: that is (to say).

τουτο.def: neuter singular nominative or accusative case of οὗτος (G3778); that thing. KJV: here (-unto), it, partly, self(-same), so, that (intent), the same, there(-fore, -unto), this, thus, where(-fore).

τουτοισ.def: dative case plural masculine or neuter of οὗτος (G3778); to (for, in, with or by) these (persons or things). KJV: such, them, there(-in, -with), these, this, those.

τουτον.def: accusative case singular masculine of οὗτος (G3778); this (person, as objective of verb or preposition). KJV: him, the same, that, this.

τουτου.def: genitive case singular masculine or neuter of οὗτος (G3778); of (from or concerning) this (person or thing). KJV: here(-by), him, it, + such manner of, that, thence(-forth), thereabout, this, thus.

τουτουσ.def: accusative case plural masculine of οὗτος (G3778); these (persons, as objective of verb or preposition). KJV: such, them, these, this.

τουτω.def: dative case singular masculine or neuter of οὗτος (G3778); to (in, with or by) this (person or thing). KJV: here(-by, -in), him, one, the same, there(-in), this.

τουτων.def: genitive case plural masculine or neuter of οὗτος (G3778); of (from or concerning) these (persons or things). KJV: such, their, these (things), they, this sort, those.

τραγοσ.def: from the base of τρώγω (G5176); a he-goat (as a gnawer). KJV: goat.

τραπεζα.def: probably contracted from τέσσαρες (G5064) and πεζῇ (G3979); a table or stool (as being four-legged), usually for food (figuratively, a meal); also a counter for money (figuratively, a broker's office for loans at interest). KJV: bank, meat, table.

τραπεζιτησ.def: from τράπεζα (G5132); a money-broker or banker. KJV: exchanger.

τραυμα.def: from the base of τιτρώσκω (to wound; akin to the base of θραύω (G2352), τρίβος (G5147), τρίζω (G5149), etc.); a wound. KJV: wound.

τραυματιζω.def: from τραῦμα (G5134); to inflict a wound. KJV: wound.

τραχηλιζω.def: from τράχηλος (G5137); to seize by the throat or neck, i.e. to expose the gullet of a victim for killing (generally, to lay bare). KJV: opened.

τραχηλοσ.def: probably from τρέχω (G5143) (through the idea of mobility); the throat (neck), i.e. (figuratively) life. KJV: neck.

τραχυσ.def: perhaps strengthened from the base of ῥήγνυμι (G4486) (as if jagged by rents); uneven, rocky (reefy). KJV: rock, rough.

τραχωνιτισ.def: from a derivative of τραχύς (G5138); rough district; Trachonitis, a region of Syria. KJV: Trachonitis.

τρεμω.def: strengthened from a primary τρέω (to "dread", "terrify"); to "tremble" or fear. KJV: be afraid, trembling.

τρεφω.def: a primary verb (properly, τρέφω; but perhaps strengthened from the base of τροπή (G5157) through the idea of convolution); properly, to stiffen, i.e. fatten (by implication, to cherish (with food, etc.), pamper, rear). KJV: bring up, feed, nourish.

τρεχω.def: apparently a primary verb (properly, θρέχω; compare θρίξ (G2359)); which uses δρέμω (the base of δρόμος (G1408)) as alternate in certain tenses; to run or walk hastily (literally or figuratively). KJV: have course, run.

τριακοντα.def: the decade of τρεῖς (G5140); thirty. KJV: thirty.

τριακοσιοι.def: plural from τρεῖς (G5140) and ἑκατόν (G1540); three hundred. KJV: three hundred.

τριβολοσ.def: from τρεῖς (G5140) and βέλος (G956); properly, a crow-foot (three-pronged obstruction in war), i.e. (by analogy) a thorny plant (caltrop). KJV: brier, thistle.

τριβοσ.def: from τρίβω (to "rub"; akin to τείρω, τρύω, and the base of τράγος (G5131), τραῦμα (G5134)); a rut or worn track. KJV: path.

τριετια.def: from a compound of τρεῖς (G5140) and ἔτος (G2094); a three years' period (triennium). KJV: space of three years.

τριζω.def: apparently a primary verb; to creak (squeak), i.e. (by analogy) to grate the teeth (in frenzy). KJV: gnash.

τριμηνον.def: neuter of a compound of τρεῖς (G5140) and μήν (G3376) as noun; a three months' space. KJV: three months.

τρισ.def: adverb from τρεῖς (G5140); three times. KJV: three times, thrice.

τριστεγον.def: neuter of a compound of τρεῖς (G5140) and στέγη (G4721) as noun; a third roof (story). KJV: third loft.

τρισχιλιοι.def: from τρίς (G5151) and χίλιοι (G5507); three times a thousand. KJV: three thousand.

τριτοσ.def: ordinal from τρεῖς (G5140); third; neuter (as noun) a third part, or (as adverb) a (or the) third time, thirdly. KJV: third(-ly).

τριχινοσ.def: from θρίξ (G2359); hairy, i.e. made of hair (mohair). KJV: of hair.

τρομοσ.def: from τρέμω (G5141); a "trembling", i.e. quaking with fear. KJV: + tremble(-ing).

τροπη.def: from an apparently primary τρέπω to turn; a turn ("trope"), i.e. revolution (figuratively, variation). KJV: turning.

τροποσ.def: from the same as τροπή (G5157); a turn, i.e. (by implication) mode or style (especially with preposition or relative prefix as adverb, like); figuratively, deportment or character. KJV: (even) as, conversation, (+ like) manner, (+ by any) means, way.

τροποφορεω.def: from τρόπος (G5158) and φορέω (G5409); to endure one's habits. KJV: suffer the manners.

τροφη.def: from τρέφω (G5142); nourishment (literally or figuratively); by implication, rations (wages). KJV: food, meat.

τροφιμοσ.def: from τροφή (G5160); nutritive; Trophimus, a Christian. KJV: Trophimus.

τροφοσ.def: from τρέφω (G5142); a nourisher, i.e. nurse. KJV: nurse.

τροχια.def: from τροχός (G5164); a track (as a wheel-rut), i.e. (figuratively) a course of conduct. KJV: path.

τροχοσ.def: from τρέχω (G5143); a wheel (as a runner), i.e. (figuratively) a circuit of physical effects. KJV: course.

τρυβλιον.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of uncertain affinity; a bowl. KJV: dish.

τρυγαω.def: from a derivative of τρύγω (to dry) meaning ripe fruit (as if dry); to collect the vintage. KJV: gather.

τρυγων.def: from τρύζω (to murmur; akin to τρίζω (G5149), but denoting a duller sound); a turtle-dove (as cooing). KJV: turtle-dove.

τρυμαλια.def: from a derivative of τρύω (to wear away; akin to the base of τραῦμα (G5134), τρίβος (G5147) and τρώγω (G5176)); an orifice, i.e. needle's eye. KJV: eye.

τρυπημα.def: from a derivative of the base of τρυμαλιά (G5168); an aperture, i.e. a needle's eye. KJV: eye.

τρυφαινα.def: from τρυφή (G5172); luxurious; Tryphæna, a Christian woman. KJV: Tryphena.

τρυφαω.def: from τρυφή (G5172); to indulge in luxury. KJV: live in pleasure.

τρυφη.def: from θρύπτω (to break up or (figuratively) enfeeble, especially the mind and body by indulgence); effeminacy, i.e. luxury or debauchery. KJV: delicately, riot.

τρυφωσα.def: from τρυφή (G5172); luxuriating; Tryphosa, a Christian female. KJV: Tryphosa.

τρωασ.def: from Τρός (a Trojan); the Troad (or plain of Troy), i.e. Troas, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Troas.

τρωγυλλιον.def: of uncertain derivation; Trogyllium, a place in Asia Minor. KJV: Trogyllium.

τρωγω.def: probably strengthened from a collateral form of the base of τραῦμα (G5134) and τρίβος (G5147) through the idea of corrosion or wear; or perhaps rather of a base of τρυγών (G5167) and τρίζω (G5149) through the idea of a craunching sound; to gnaw or chew, i.e. (generally) to eat. KJV: eat.

τυγχανω.def: probably for an obsolete τύχω (for which the middle voice of another alternate τεύχω (to make ready or bring to pass) is used in certain tenses; akin to the base of τίκτω (G5088) through the idea of effecting; properly, to affect; or (specially), to hit or light upon (as a mark to be reached), i.e. (transitively) to attain or secure an object or end, or (intransitively) to happen (as if meeting with); but in the latter application only impersonal (with εἰ (G1487)), i.e. perchance; or (present participle) as adjective, usual (as if commonly met with, with οὐ (G3756), extraordinary), neuter (as adverb) perhaps; or (with another verb) as adverb, by accident (as it were). KJV: be, chance, enjoy, little, obtain, X refresh…self, + special.

τυμπανιζω.def: from a derivative of τύπτω (G5180) (meaning a drum, "tympanum"); to stretch on an instrument of torture resembling a drum, and thus beat to death. KJV: torture.

τυποσ.def: from τύπτω (G5180); a die (as struck), i.e. (by implication) a stamp or scar; by analogy, a shape, i.e. a statue, (figuratively) style or resemblance; specially, a sampler ("type"), i.e. a model (for imitation) or instance (for warning). KJV: en-(ex-)ample, fashion, figure, form, manner, pattern, print.

τυπτω.def: a primary verb (in a strengthened form); to "thump", i.e. cudgel or pummel (properly, with a stick or bastinado), but in any case by repeated blows; thus differing from παίω (G3817) and πατάσσω (G3960), which denote a (usually single) blow with the hand or any instrument, or πλήσσω (G4141) with the fist (or a hammer), or ῥαπίζω (G4474) with the palm; as well as from τυγχάνω (G5177), an accidental collision); by implication, to punish; figuratively, to offend (the conscience). KJV: beat, smite, strike, wound.

τυραννοσ.def: a provincial form of the derivative of the base of κύριος (G2962); a "tyrant"; Tyrannus, an Ephesian. KJV: Tyrannus.

τυρβαζω.def: from τύρβη (Latin turba, a crowd; akin to θόρυβος (G2351)); to make "turbid", i.e. disturb. KJV: trouble.

τυριοσ.def: from Τύρος (G5184); a Tyrian, i.e. inhabitant of Tyrus. KJV: of Tyre.

τυροσ.def: of Hebrew origin (H6865): Tyrus (i.e. Tsor), a place in Palestine. KJV: Tyre.

τυφλοσ.def: from, τυφόω (G5187); opaque (as if smoky), i.e. (by analogy) blind (physically or mentally). KJV: blind.

τυφλοω.def: from τυφλός (G5185); to make blind, i.e. (figuratively) to obscure. KJV: blind.

τυφοω.def: from a derivative of τύφω (G5188); to envelop with smoke, i.e. (figuratively) to inflate with self-conceit. KJV: high-minded, be lifted up with pride, be proud.

τυφω.def: apparently a primary verb; to make a smoke, i.e. slowly consume without flame. KJV: smoke.

τυφωνικοσ.def: from a derivative of τύφω (G5188); stormy (as if smoky). KJV: tempestuous.

τυχικοσ.def: from a derivative of τυγχάνω (G5177); fortuitous, i.e. fortunate; Tychicus, a Christian. KJV: Tychicus.
